# CMS TEAM Impact Report · Rebuild portfolio

Five timeline-ordered versions of Rainfall Health’s **CMS TEAM Impact Report** — from Annabelle’s **Jun 25, 2026** Word draft through the **Jul 27 published** PDF, audit redlines, and the **market-ready corrected final** (data-driven, fully cited).

[Compare versions](compare.qmd){.btn-rain} [Audit materials](audit-materials.qmd){.btn-rain-outline}
:::
